fewShots.question: Which open purchase order lines are past their promised delivery date?
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP 25 l.purchase_order_id, l.line_number, s.supplier_name, p.project_name, m.material_description,
       pd.date AS promised_delivery_date, l.line_amount_nok
FROM dbo.fact_purchase_order_line l
JOIN dbo.dim_date pd ON l.promised_delivery_date_key = pd.date_key
JOIN dbo.dim_supplier s ON l.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
JOIN dbo.dim_project p ON l.project_key = p.project_key
JOIN dbo.dim_material m ON l.material_key = m.material_key
WHERE l.line_status IN ('Open', 'Partially received') AND pd.date < '2026-10-08'
ORDER BY pd.date;

fewShots.question: List the late deliveries for critical spare parts.
fewShots.query:
SELECT l.purchase_order_id, l.line_number, s.supplier_name, m.material_description, l.delivery_delay_days
FROM dbo.fact_purchase_order_line l
JOIN dbo.dim_material m ON l.material_key = m.material_key
JOIN dbo.dim_supplier s ON l.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
WHERE l.is_late_delivery = 1 AND m.is_critical_spare = 1
ORDER BY l.delivery_delay_days DESC;
